The obligations of the Mortgagor and the related non-recourse carveout guarantors, each as environmental indemnitor, under the related environmental indemnity agreement will terminate and be of no further force and effect after the date that is 24 months after the date on which, among other things, (i) the Mortgage Loan is paid in full in the ordinary course and (ii) the indemnitor delivers a satisfactory environmental report in accordance with the related environmental indemnity agreement.
